Description
Texas A&M University–Corpus Christi is a public research university in Corpus Christi, Texas. It is part of the Texas A&M University System and classified among "R2: Doctoral Universities – High research activity". Texas A&M University—Corpus Christi's ranking as #298-#389 in the 2021 edition of Best Colleges is National Universities.
